description: In Codex, surface governing pi-canon capsules after each tool result and remind once about durable updates before stop.

hooks.command: root="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}"; script="$root/scripts/pi-canon-hook.mjs"; if [ ! -f "$script" ]; then parent="${root%/*}"; for candidate in "$parent"/*/scripts/pi-canon-hook.mjs; do [ -f "$candidate" ] && script="$candidate"; done; fi; exec node "$script"
